items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: We was over in Bass St. Louis with Madeline and guitar. Bass. And Bassier was sitting out there on the trunces, you know. And we happened to come out.

ctx.x: And that way, uh, Bassier used to come in there and, uh, Jimbo, let Bassier play, you know. Them fellas down in the district, a fella come and complain if they, they leave you there on the job and they go on off, you know.
